mapper.select: select id, dict_code, dict_label, dict_value, parent_id, tag_type, sort, status, remark, if(parent_id = 0, '顶级', (select bdp.menu_name from bedrock_menu bdp where bdp.id = bedrock_dict.parent_id)) as parentName from bedrock_dict where id = #{id}

select id, dict_code, dict_label, dict_value, tag_type, (exists(select 1 from bedrock_dict bdh where bdh.parent_id = bedrock_dict.id and bdh.is_deleted = 0)) as hasChildren from bedrock_dict where dict_code = #{dictCode} and is_deleted = 0 and status = 1
and parent_id in ( select id from bedrock_dict where parent_id = 0 and dict_code = #{dictCode} and is_deleted = 0 and status = 1 )
and parent_id = #{parentId}
order by sort, create_time desc
